2. Follow the Chain of Command - You are expected to follow the Chain of Command. - Example: If you are a Quartermaster, you listen to the Captain or ACO. - The process of selecting an ACO is detailed further in the Guidebook. A generalization of the process is as: - No Captain? Head of Personnel is in charge! - No Captain or Head of Personnel? Head of Security is in charge! - No Captain, Head of Personnel, or Head of Security? All of command votes for an ACO! - No Command? The crew votes!
##Examples - As a Research Director, you are expected to listen and follow the orders of the Captain or of Central Command members. - As a Security Officer, you are expected to listen to and follow the orders of the Head of Security. - As a Detective, you are expected to NOT barge into the medical department and order them around.
